subject: Trading
title: The China Stock Crash: 2015
description: A fast breakdown of The China Stock Crash: 2015 for builders.

hook.text: Chinese stocks rose 150% in a year as millions of new retail investors opened accounts. Then the bubble burst.

buildup.text: State media encouraged investing. Farmers, taxi drivers, and college students borrowed to buy stocks on margin.

discovery.text: The Shanghai Composite fell 40% in weeks. The government froze IPOs, banned selling, and arrested short sellers.

twist.text: Government intervention temporarily stabilized prices but destroyed market credibility and foreign investor trust.

climax.text: The crash showed that new investors plus leverage plus government encouragement is a dangerous combination.

punchline.text: When a government promotes a bubble, the crash is political too.

quiz.question: How did China respond to the 2015 stock crash?
options: Froze IPOs, banned selling, and arrested short sellers
